description:
ABOUT : Team Tiny Sparks, a multidisciplinary team of six school students united by one belief: Space Education Is for Everyone.

Combining research, technology, design, and storytelling, we created Adopt a Satellite—an interactive educational project that brings the stories of abandoned NASA space exploration hardware closer to young minds.

We believe that every space mission leaves behind more than hardware. It leaves behind discoveries, memories, and stories worth remembering.
